parameters.excerpt: The implemented number and width of these additional counters, and the set of events they count, are platform-specific.
parameters.reasoning: The number of implemented HPM counters (hpmcounter3–hpmcounter31) is platform-specific, meaning the implementer chooses which of the up to 29 counters are actually implemented. This is a design-time choice matching the known HPM_COUNTER_EN parameter.

parameters.excerpt: Accessing an unimplemented counter may cause an illegal-instruction exception or may return a constant value.
